notes: אִתּוֹ here is the preposition H854 'with', not the object marker H853, so it aligns ordinarily under rule 11.

'the seed royal' and 'the mighty of the land' are handled by rule 29's two branches: one written 'the' goes to the rectum's article in the fronted case, two written 'the's split between construct and rectum in the arthrous case.
